I think the overall case and the answers to the questions could have been explained properly.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECase : 7 https:\/\/02shishirareddy.blogspot.com\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Diagnosis : Alcohol induced dementia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReview : Causes for electrolyte imbalance:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Respiratory acidosis with metabolic alkalosis(due to renal compensation) in AECOPD patientswith chronic hypercapnia is the usual cause ofhypochloremia in these patient Commoncauses ofderanged serum sodium levels include hyperglycemia, use of thiazides or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, congestive cardiac failure, chronic renal failure, and low dietary salt intake.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Common causes of hypokalemia include diarrhea, laxative abuse, vomiting, certain diuretics, drugs like insulin, β2agonists, and theophylline.20 Thus, COPD patients per\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ese are predisposed to electrolyte imbalance. In turn electrolyte imbalance can cause respiratory muscle weakness, cardiac arrhythmia, low cardiac output.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Thus the presence of electrolyte imbalance leads to significantly poor outcome among COPD patients.It is very interesting to know about the acidosis and very happy to read and get the knowledge about respiratory acidosis .it is really very helpful .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy review-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe history of present and past illness is coherent and well established. The videos are great for understanding the case. The case sheet has captured all the relevant data in the right order. Correct terminology was used. The reports of all the lab investigations conducted were given.\u0026nbsp;The pharmacological intervention was elaborate and explained well.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe symptomatology with anatomical localization and primary etiology was explained very well. The explanation was done with help of diagrams which made it easier to understand. The treatment part was also explained with all the drugs and injections that were given to the patient. The causes that are explained for acute exacerbation and for electrolyte imbalance were appropriate. At last all the questions were answered and case was handled well.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECase :8 https\/\/savanthreddy.blogspot.com\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiagnosis : INFECTIOUS DISEASE (Mucormycosis)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReview : What are the postulated reasons for a sudden apparent rise in the incidence of mucormycosis in India at this point of time?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI think it is because of the use steroids in an uncontrolled manner.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECOVID 19 is not the first disease where steroids are used as one of the main stay of treatment (in severe cases) but what has gone wrong in the recent time is even the lay man who got infected with Corona started using steroids right from the day 1 with no monitoring by a specialised physician.And they are not following any specific course of treatment.As many of them are also diabetic patients the are getting succumbed to mucormycosis.And it is not ending with mucormycosis but various other fungii are emerging to cause an epidemic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnd another reason for rise in mucormycosis cases may be the usage of tap water in oxygen concentrators.As most of the patients are being diagnosed of Covid in late stages in the second wave many of them Are requiring oxygen concentrators for supplemental oxygenation.And due to Lack of the people are using tap water instead of distilled water which serves as reservoir for the growth of mucormycosis.So this may be one of the reason for rise in mucormycosis cases. I feel really happy by reading this new information about the disease that is happening in our india and it is very well explained with the good image and reason behind the this epidemic\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy review-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEvolution of symptomatology was listed in a chronological order which was easy to understand. Only non-pharmacological interventions were explained, could have been better if pharmacological interventions were also included. The cause for acute exacerbation in this case was not explained in detail. Overall, the answers to the questions could have been answered in a\u0026nbsp; better way by adding some of the elements as mentioned above and explaining them in detail.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECase 9 : https:\/\/gsuhithagnaneswar.blogspot.com\/?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiagnosis : cervical spondylosis Recurrent hypokalemic paralysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Review : What are the reasons for recurrence of hypokalemia in her? \u0026nbsp; Alcohol use(excessive\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Chronic kidney disease\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Diabetic ketoacidosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4.\u0026nbsp; History was taken well\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere are no clinical pics of the symptoms like pedal edema.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProper chronological order of symptoms apperance was not done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever chart was not included.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo IO charting was done though it was told it should be strictly monitored\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy Analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is case of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAcute renal failure (intrinsic)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Grade 1 L4-L5 Spondylodiscitis, Multifocal infectious Spondylodiscitis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHyperuricemia 2° to Renal failure\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUraemia induced tremors( resolved)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDelerium 2° to septic \/Uremic encephalopathy (resolving)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECKD :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/krupalatha54.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/a-49-yr-old-female-with-generalized.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver view\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 49 yr old female , mother of 2 children, who is a house wife, apparently asymptomatic 13 yrs ago and then she noticed mass per anum with bleeding , went to hospital and diagnosed as haemorrhoids and got operated.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Since 3 yrs she has history of muscle aches, for which she is using NSAIDs.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- She has h\/o fever 20 days back, got treated in the local hospital, and\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Since 20 days she has generalized weakness.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- She also has h\/o vomitings since 3 days, with food as content, non - 70% plasmacytosis).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient with coma and renal failure\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/ananyapulikandala106.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/a-35yr-old-female-elog.html\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOverview\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 35 yr old female with Fever and Diarrhea since 5 days( 4 to 5 times a day with blood discharge).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBack pain( 5 days ago) with abdominal pain and chest pain.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EApprisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVery well presented\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWith good fever charting with all the necessary information.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory was taken detailed way\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFollow up was good\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAll the tests were properly done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI could not find the negative data in the elog\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt could be the hypoxia which could have caused the permanent brain damage which was the reason for her vegetative state .
